name: Lens-broken twin route renders the widget alone

planSteps.description: Take the address of the page already open, keep everything before '#' exactly as it is, and open it with '#/l/virtual-list/lens-broken' after it (for example .../#/l/virtual-list/lens-broken). Do not go to any other site address. Wait 3 seconds
Verify the page shows the heading 'Virtual list', the text 'Selected: none' and a list starting with 'Item 1'
Verify the page shows no 'Eye Chart' heading and no chart, so the widget is rendered alone
